reason: With my cousin charging $600 a year, I'd want a reason to trust a $199-a-month stranger and a low-risk way to try her, and A gives me both: no contract, out with 30 days' notice, and open admissions about the 3 missed deadlines and the price increase. B leaves out the misses and the price history, and it promises books my accountant 'won't have to fix', which isn't in the facts, so A feels more honest and more likely to get me to book.
